bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.title: Malformed run state accepted silently
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.description: A run.json missing required fields (goal, mode) is not rejected by execute_run. It returns status='completed' with no error.

bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.title: Auto write-intent escalation not reflected in run state
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.description: governance.mode_requires_escalation correctly detects auto+write intent, but LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 keeps mode_effective=auto after create_run/execute_run.

bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.title: No internal timeout/circuit-breaker for graph invocation
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.description: execute_run has no internal timeout. A stalled graph node causes the call to hang until an external timeout or process kill.

bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.title: Test-harness artifact for missing token header
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.description: require_strict_operator_access is an async FastAPI dependency. Direct synchronous invocation returns a coroutine instead of raising 401/403. Real FastAPI awaits it correctly.

notes: All report-only constraints respected. Three production failure-mode/governance gaps and one test harness artifact were exposed and documented. Local phase1-ci and nontrading-smoke-regression subset passed (09e backend-dependent tests require GITHUB_ACTIONS env to skip; under GitHub Actions they will be skipped).
